$comment: Chip capability axes for the Omarchy backend, agreed 2026-09-11 between the chip-portability audit and the capability-simulation harness. Names are the contract; both deliverables and the harness profiles use them verbatim. Axis values are what the backend actually queries (device.cpp collect_capabilities) or derives; gate line references are origin/main 21710dfb.

axes.name: driver_variant
axes.meaning: Which Vulkan driver build serves the chip. Gates nothing by itself but selects the arithmetic contract and the digest pin set: digests are pinned per driver BUILD, not per chip.
axes.m2_known: expected honeykrisp family (Asahi G14 GPU acceleration is upstream); build identity unmeasured
axes.m1_max_macos: Metal-side, not a Vulkan value: runtime Metal JIT on macOS 26.6.2 (25G83), Apple metal 32023.883 (metalfe-32023.883); pinned-MLX kernels compile clean through it (receipts/2026-09-11-m1max-macos-capture/mlx-kernels)
m1_max_unknown: honeykrisp build identity under Omarchy (driverID + driverInfo string) - it becomes the digest-pin key
all six digest pins on that build

axes.name: cooperative_matrix_fp32_8x8x8
axes.source: VK_KHR_cooperative_matrix listed AND cooperativeMatrix feature AND an enumerated 8x8x8 all-FLOAT32 subgroup-scope non-saturating shape (device.cpp:274-297)
axes.meaning: Gates QmmPrefillCoopmatF16, MatmulF32Coopmat, MatmulBF16Coopmat, SdpaDecodeNative. Absent = routes fall to tile/scalar kernels with different accumulation order.
m2_unknown: presence under the M2 driver build
axes.m1_max_macos: simdgroup_matrix<float,8,8> compiled, executed and bit-exact vs a CPU fp32 reference (runtime probe); Metal has no cooperative-matrix extension - this is the hardware capability underneath it. simdgroup_matrix at f16 and bf16 also compiles and executes (scalar-exact; see receipt caveat on 16-bit layout assumptions)
m1_max_unknown: VK_KHR_cooperative_matrix enumeration + feature + enumerated 8x8x8 fp32 shape under the Omarchy driver

axes.name: subgroup_size
axes.meaning: All subgroup gates test == 32 exactly, never divisibility. Shader kernels hard-code 32-lane slots; a shader compiled for a wrong size sums wrongly, so the host gate is the only guard (qmm_vec.comp:70-79).
m2_unknown: reported size under the M2 driver

axes.name: subgroup_ops_mask

bits_consumed.ARITHMETIC: qmm_vec subgroup + Q4-word + multi-weight decode GEMV (primitives.cpp:6687-6689, 6999-7000, 6466-6468)
bits_consumed.SHUFFLE_RELATIVE: dense BF16 decode GEMV, matmul_vec.comp USE_BF16 (primitives.cpp:629)

axes.m1_g13_reference: BASIC|ARITHMETIC|SHUFFLE|SHUFFLE_RELATIVE proven present (all four consumed by enabled routes); full mask not dumped in-repo
axes.m1_max_macos: no Metal mask-query API; runtime evidence is compile+execute of the simd-consuming pinned kernels: sdpa_vector (simd-index attributes, no simdgroup_matrix) and steel mma.h simdgroup_matrix exact at fp32 with scalar-exact f16/bf16 multiply (receipts/2026-09-11-m1max-macos-capture)
m1_max_unknown: full supportedOperations mask under the Omarchy driver

axes.name: shared_memory_limit_bytes
axes.meaning: Consumers: 4096 (qmm_coopmat.comp, matmul_coopmat_bf16.comp), 21504 (sdpa_decode_native.comp). fft_c2c.comp uses exactly 16384 = the Vulkan spec floor; linalg/sort/reduce shaders stay at or under it. The historical 'cliff above 4 KiB' is now queried, not assumed (primitives.cpp:570-579, 6577-6585).
axes.m1_g13_reference: >= 21504 (gate-proven floor: SdpaDecodeNative enabled on the reference driver); exact limit not dumped in-repo
axes.m1_max_macos_note: MTLDevice.maxThreadgroupMemoryLength, runtime; dynamic threadgroup allocation at the full 32768 B executed and byte-verified

axes.name: workgroup_limits
axes.meaning: sdpa_decode_native (local_size 1024) is gated on >= 1024/1024 (primitives.cpp:10302-10303). Every other kernel hard-codes local_size 256 (64 coopmat, 32 matmul_vec) with NO runtime check (F-03); Vulkan spec floor is 128 invocations.
axes.m1_g13_reference: >= 1024 invocations and >= 1024 size_x (gate-proven floor); exact values not dumped in-repo
axes.m1_max_macos_note: MTLDevice.maxThreadsPerThreadgroup (MTLSize), runtime; a 1024-wide single-threadgroup dispatch completed and verified
m1_max_unknown: all four fields under the Omarchy driver

axes.name: atomic_float_add
axes.meaning: Selects ScatterFAdd (hardware atomicAdd) vs ScatterFCas (compare-exchange add, exact-arithmetic twin). M1 Honeykrisp does not advertise the extension; llvmpipe does. The model capability-keyed route.
m2_unknown: extension presence under the M2 driver build
axes.m1_max_macos_note: device atomic_float add executed, exact at 1048576 accumulates (runtime probe). Asymmetry the audit needs: the base-M1 Linux reference reads false only because honeykrisp does not advertise VK_EXT_shader_atomic_float - the M1 hardware can do it; whether this die's Omarchy driver advertises it is exactly what must be re-measured
m1_max_unknown: VK_EXT_shader_atomic_float + shaderBufferFloat32AtomicAdd advertisement under the Omarchy driver

axes.name: memory_model
axes.source: memory heap/type walk: host-visible+coherent type inside a device-local heap (device.cpp:184-205); allocator falls back to HOST_VISIBLE with explicit flush/invalidate (allocator.h:20-24)
axes.m2_known: uma_coherent (Apple UMA is an architecture fact, not a driver measurement)
axes.m1_max_macos_note: MTLDevice.hasUnifiedMemory true (runtime); recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize ~55.7 GB of 64 GB, argument buffers tier2, maxBufferLength ~38.9 GiB

axes.name: digest_policy
axes.source: policy, not a device property. docs/parity-id-policy.md amendment 2026-09-10 + receipts/2026-09-10-prefill-qmm-isa/driver-portability-defect.json
axes.meaning: Generated-id digests are pinned per driver build (driverInfo git hash), never per chip. A new chip means a new driver build means fresh pins; native-matching legs (Q4 short, Q4 1K-context, BF16 1K-context) must still equal native.

m1_g13_reference.note: Same chip, same capability bits, different driver builds: q4_longctx and bf16_long differ. Proof that pins ride the driver build.

m2_unknown: all six pins until measured on the M2's driver build
axes.m1_max_macos: policy unchanged (per_driver_build); this die's native macOS legs are already recorded in receipts/2026-09-10-native-macos-metal-baseline (Q4 286.96/296.25/283.79, BF16 217.88/214.72/207.95 tok/s, reference native digests reproduced)
m1_max_unknown: all six pins on the Omarchy driver build this machine receives

per_chip_expectations.m1_g13: reference row; every value measured or gate-proven on jwm1-linux
per_chip_expectations.m1_max: this machine; macOS-side analogues of every axis runtime-measured pre-install in receipts/2026-09-11-m1max-macos-capture (applegpu_g13s, 32 GPU cores, threadExecutionWidth 32, threadgroup memory 32768 B verified, maxThreadsPerThreadgroup 1024^3 dispatched, argument buffers tier2, unified memory, device atomic_float add exact, GPU blit copy roof 306 GB/s median / CPU memcpy roof 190 GB/s); every Linux/Vulkan-side value below stays unknown until Omarchy qualification on this die - the m1_g13 reference row (8-core g13g) is NOT valid for it
per_chip_expectations.m2_max: target once Omarchy lands on it: memory_model known (uma_coherent); driver_variant, coopmat, subgroup, shared, workgroup, atomic_float_add, and all six digests must be measured at qualification time
per_chip_expectations.m3: Asahi has installer support but software rendering only: no Honeykrisp GPU driver -> backend refuses at device discovery unless run under a software driver via MLX_OMARCHY_ALLOW_NON_APPLE=1 (development only)
per_chip_expectations.m4: GPU support TBA upstream: everything unknown
per_chip_expectations.m5_m6: arrive ~2026-10: everything unknown; all axes must come from runtime discovery, never from a chip-name table
